notes: This is the complete public tool surface: exactly four tools returned by tools/list, each answering with an ordinary MCP tool response.
There is no harness_events, harness_status, harness_list, worker report/ask/wait, reply/approve/continue or process-log tool.
The harness_wait tool response is the result delivery channel. Ending the wait window or cancelling that tool call never stops the worker.
Domain failures are returned as structured tool errors carrying {"code": <stable code>, "message": <safe text>}. Unknown tools and malformed arguments are MCP protocol errors.
A repo-wide check: tools.json lists exactly [harness_health, harness_submit, harness_wait, harness_cancel].
UNKNOWN_TOOL is surfaced as a JSON-RPC -32602 protocol error (unknown tool), not as a structured tool error; malformed arguments and unknown fields use the same -32602 path.

tools.name: harness_health
tools.description: Return this instance_id, the configured adapter versions, declared capabilities and limits. Read-only: no credential probe and no worker spawn.

response_fields.instance_id: string; required by every harness_submit call and invalidated when the bridge process changes
response_fields.adapters: array of {id, configured, compatible, version?, minimum_version?, non_interactive, needs_input}
response_fields.limits: object {max_active_jobs, max_retained_jobs, max_final_bytes, max_protocol_bytes, default_deadline_at: null, consumption_budget: null}
response_fields.capabilities: object {persistent_state: false, cross_instance_dedupe: false, restart_recovery: false, wait_cancel_keeps_job: true, optional_markdown_result: true, process_logs_exposed: false}

tools.name: harness_submit
tools.description: Freeze one task and accept it for a configured worker adapter. Returns job_id, accepted and whether an identical request_id payload was reused. Runs no process log and writes no task file.

parameters.name: instance_id
parameters.description: Current bridge instance_id from harness_health. A stale id fails with INSTANCE_CHANGED.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Caller-chosen request identity, scoped to this bridge instance. The same id with the same payload reuses the accepted job; a different payload fails with REQUEST_CONFLICT.

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: Configured workspace id; task_file inputs resolve under this root.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Task text. Exactly one of prompt or task_file must be supplied.

parameters.name: task_file
parameters.description: Task file resolved under the workspace root. Exactly one of prompt or task_file must be supplied.

parameters.name: save_result
parameters.description: Publish one final Markdown result after the terminal state. Default false; true requires a configured results_dir.

parameters.name: deadline_at
parameters.description: Explicit RFC3339 task deadline in the future. There is no default task deadline.

response_fields.job_id: string; unique within the bridge instance
response_fields.status: string; accepted, running or a terminal status
response_fields.reused: boolean; true when an identical request_id payload reused the existing job

tools.name: harness_wait
tools.description: Wait for a job's terminal result or for this call's wait window. A pending response is minimal. Ending or cancelling this call does not stop the worker.

parameters.name: wait_ms
parameters.description: Wait window for this single tool call in milliseconds. Omit to wait until the worker reaches a terminal state. This is not a task timeout and expiry never stops the worker.

response_fields.status: string; present when state is pending (accepted or running) and when state is final
response_fields.elapsed_ms: integer; present when state is pending; duration of this wait call only, not job age
response_fields.result: FinalResult (contracts/final-result.schema.json); present when state is final

tools.name: harness_cancel
tools.description: Explicitly cancel a job and return its terminal result plus process cleanup evidence. Repeated calls are idempotent.

response_fields.cancelled: boolean; true when the terminal status is cancelled

error_codes.INVALID_REQUEST: Malformed request or invalid parameter combination; rejected before any job is accepted or process spawned.
error_codes.UNKNOWN_TOOL: The requested tool name is not one of the four tools above.
error_codes.INSTANCE_CHANGED: instance_id does not belong to this bridge process (stale or previous instance); the request is not converted into a new job.
error_codes.REQUEST_CONFLICT: request_id was already used with a different payload; the original job and frozen input are unchanged.
error_codes.BUSY: The instance already has max_active_jobs active jobs; new submissions are refused, not queued, and existing jobs keep running.
error_codes.MEMORY_CAPACITY: The instance job table is at max_retained_jobs; records needed for deduplication are not evicted.
error_codes.PATH_OUTSIDE_ROOT: task_file resolves outside the configured workspace root after canonicalization.
error_codes.TASK_READ_FAILED: task_file cannot be resolved, is not a regular file, is not UTF-8, or exceeds max_prompt_bytes.
error_codes.ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE: The requested adapter id is not configured in this bridge instance.
error_codes.INCOMPATIBLE_CLI: The configured adapter version is below the adapter's supported minimum.
error_codes.AUTH_REQUIRED: Native authentication, credential or provider-business failure (for example a 403 insufficient-balance result); no credential file is read and no retry is attempted.
error_codes.WORKER_FAILED: Native turn failure or execution failure not classified as auth, rate-limit or needs-input.
error_codes.NEEDS_INPUT: The worker natively requested approval or human input; the bridge neither approves nor proxies a prompt.
error_codes.STREAM_INCOMPLETE: The native terminal success frame is missing, conflicting or unparseable; a partial answer may be returned with output_complete=false.
error_codes.SPAWN_FAILED: The worker process could not be started.
error_codes.CLEANUP_UNCONFIRMED: Process-tree cleanup could not be confirmed; the active slot stays occupied and no false release is reported.
error_codes.JOB_NOT_FOUND: job_id is unknown in this bridge instance.
error_codes.JOB_CONTEXT_LOST: The job belongs to a different or ended bridge instance; the bridge does not recover or replay it.
error_codes.RESULT_TOO_LARGE: The final answer or protocol frame exceeded the configured receive limit; reported as a delivery_error and output_complete=false.
error_codes.REPORT_WRITE_FAILED: The optional final Markdown result could not be published; the worker result is unchanged and the worker is not re-run.
error_codes.SENSITIVE_PAYLOAD: A result or error payload cannot be delivered safely after redaction.
error_codes.CONFIG_INVALID: The trusted bridge configuration is invalid.
error_codes.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: An explicitly configured task deadline was reached; the terminal status is timed_out.
error_codes.INTERRUPTED: Bridge shutdown or stdio EOF stopped the job before a native terminal state.
